text: Welcome Jialin Wang, joining the lab as a Postdoc!
Welcome our new MPhil students — Shihua Deng, Huayuan Chen, and Yi Gao!
Welcome Rongkai Shi, joining the lab as a Postdoc!

Hai-Ning Liang, joined by postdoctoral researcher Rongkai Shi, lectured on virtual and mixed reality for art creation and immersive experiences in a National Arts Fund-supported training programme in Guangzhou.
The FIT-AWE Lab is established at the Computational Media and Arts Thrust, HKUST(GZ). We are recruiting PhD/MPhil students, postdocs, and research assistants.
Hai-Ning Liang shared how exploration, computational thinking, and programming can inspire creative learning in a TEDxYouth@Suzhou talk.
